messages:
Maya L: Quick triage thread for outstanding postmortem follow-ups before the cross-region game-day. Need owners for: routing affinity rollback doc, backup verification automation, and restore timeout hard-stop.
Ethan R: I9ll take routing affinity rollback. Plan: write a one-page rollback play, test in staging. Acceptance: doc + staging test logs showing rollback sequence within 5m. Due: 2026-04-20.
Zoe C: backup verification automation sounds like my lane. Will wire a nightly sampler that compares checksums and raises an alert if variance >0.75%. Acceptance: job + alert rule + sample alerts. Due: 2026-04-18.
Ben H: restore timeout hard-stop: I9ll add a watchdog that aborts stuck restores after configurable TTL and surfaces artifacts. Acceptance: PR + integration test. Due: 2026-04-19.
Maya L: please add actions to the tracker (link below) with acceptance artifacts. We want these closed before the rehearsal on 2026-04-22. https://docs.internal/redwood/dr/followups-2026
Ethan R: recurring pattern note: ingress reweight after control-plane GC. Adding a 1-line lead indicator in tracker: weight-sync >15s.
Zoe C: small note for S3 restores: include re-list + 30s sleep to avoid eventual-consistency flaps. Adding to acceptance.
Ben H: blocker: need db-read creds for smoke. @PagerBot can you create a short-lived db reader role?
PagerBot: Created temp-role db-read-game-178888 with expiry 2026-04-23T00:00:00Z. Secret stored in 1Password under incidents/dr-game-day.
Maya L: great. once done, paste PR links + 1-paragraph validation note in the tracker. I9ll compile for the postmortem packet.
Ethan R: ack, will paste logs.
Zoe C: ack.
Ben H: ack.
